cases.name: valid
cases.description: The installation's install configuration: key set (1, 1) and recovery key version 1.

cases.name: inner_document_replaced_without_resigning
cases.description: The address document inside is replaced by another validly signed one, and the install configuration keeps its old signature.

cases.name: foreign_deployment_cert_own_install_key
cases.description: The valid deployment certificate of another installation, globex, with the configuration signed by acme's own install signing key.

cases.name: foreign_deployment_cert_foreign_install_key
cases.description: The deployment certificate of globex, the configuration signed again by globex's install signing key, and its install_id still acme.

cases.name: vendor_test_key_not_trusted
cases.description: The deployment certificate is signed under vendor-test-1, which is in the vendor key list, and vendor test keys are not trusted.

cases.name: vendor_test_key_trusted
cases.description: The same install configuration, with vendor test keys trusted.

cases.name: vendor_kid_out_of_grammar_test_keys_not_trusted
cases.description: The deployment certificate is signed under vendor-other-1, which follows neither vendor kid prefix and so is in no vendor key list; vendor test keys not trusted.

cases.name: vendor_kid_out_of_grammar_test_keys_trusted
cases.description: The deployment certificate is signed under vendor-other-1, which follows neither vendor kid prefix and so is in no vendor key list; vendor test keys trusted.

cases.name: rotated_keyset_v3
cases.description: The key set is version 3 of epoch 1, after two rotations, signed by its own current_kid.

cases.name: recovered_keyset_resigned_by_current_kid
cases.description: The key set (2, 1) of a recovery, the copy signed again by its own current_kid.

cases.name: recovered_keyset_recovery_signed
cases.description: The key set (2, 1) of a recovery, the copy the recovery key signed.
